basic_info.description: Perched high on its fully detached lot 323 Chicago Way has beautiful views from the living room bay window including Mt. Davidson, Twin Peaks, Sutro Tower, the Bank of America Building and city lights. There are built-in bookcases surrounding the fireplace and hardwood floors. The adjacent dining room has hardwood floors, a bay window and a pass-through to the wet bar. There is a bedroom next to the dining room with a Murphy bed and built-in cabinets. The bath has a low step shower stall and built in cabinets. The large eat-in kitchen is great for cooking, baking and entertaining with a built-in electric oven, free standing gas range and a center island with a Jen-Air cooktop. There is a side by side refrigerator, dishwasher and room for a large table. This room has several windows for great light. The rear hallway has built-in cabinets, a stack washer/dryer and leads to a serene bedroom with several windows. The kitchen door leads to a back deck and patio area. Downstairs there is a huge garage with a workbench, laundry sink, furnace, water heater, circuit breakers and room for a couple of cars. The number 43 bus stops on this street and highways 101, 280, and  Bart are nearby.. McLaren Park and San Bruno Mountain recreation areas are nearby. Home loved by seller for 62 years.
